node.name: Hono, Bun, Deno, Workers
node.code:
// the route: any handler that takes a Request
import { proxy } from 'trckable/server'

const forward = proxy({ host: 'https://stats.example.com', proxyKey: process.env.TRCKABLE_PROXY_KEY })
app.post('/api/e', (c) => forward(c.req.raw))

# .env
TRCKABLE_PROXY_KEY=your-proxy-key

<!-- every page, in <head> -->
<script
  defer
  data-site="tkb_a1b2c3d4"
  data-domain="example.com"
  data-api="/api/e"
  src="https://stats.example.com/js/tkb_a1b2c3d4.js">
</script>

server.name: Server-side (any language)
server.code:
curl -X POST https://stats.example.com/api/e \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H "user-agent: <the visitor's browser user agent>" \
  -d '{"s":"tkb_a1b2c3d4","k":"pv","u":"https://example.com/pricing"}'
